    A=np.vander(t,deg+1)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,r0,rcond=None)[0]
    print('t-only deg',deg, np.sum((A@c-r0)**2))

c=np.linalg.lstsq(Xf,r0,rcond=None)[0]
print('full poly', np.sum((Xf@c-r0)**2), Xf.shape)

import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dv_dt
def resid(p, deg=8):
    a,b,c=p
    base=a*np.sqrt(v)+b*np.sin(c*v)*np.sqrt(x)
    r=y-base
    A=np.vander(t/8.0,deg+1)
    co=np.linalg.lstsq(A,r,rcond=None)[0]
    return r-A@co
best=None
for s in range(30):
    p0=np.random.RandomState(s).uniform(-2,2,3)
    r=least_squares(resid,p0)
    if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
print(best.x, 2*best.cost)
